_comment: BreachLoop is a single self-contained Next.js app: the UI and every /api/* route are deployed by one Vercel project. The previous file declared a non-existent `services` schema (`backend` FastAPI + `frontend` Vite) and rewrites pointing at it, which Vercel ignored — every /api request fell through to the static frontend and failed. Function limits live in the route segment config (app/api/**/route.ts -> `export const maxDuration`).
